summary: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 8-K on October 6, 2026, furnishing an updated investor presentation under Item 7.01 and disclosing a press release updating its January 2027 hospitalized babesiosis data readout timeline under Item 8.01. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is stated. The filing is a routine Regulation FD disclosure and clinical-timeline update by the Nasdaq-listed issuer, not a special situation. Watch for the actual data readout and any subsequent capital-markets or partnering activity.
